title: AI Portfolio Assistant
description: Retrieval-augmented AI chatbot that answers recruiter questions about my experience, projects, and technical skills using semantic search, vector embeddings, and grounded responses.
howItWorks: Portfolio documents are converted into vector embeddings using the OpenAI Embeddings API and stored in a Supabase pgvector database. When a recruiter asks a question, the application creates an embedding of the query, performs a semantic similarity search to retrieve the most relevant portfolio documents, and provides those results as context to the language model using a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflow. Responses are streamed to the frontend in real time with the Vercel AI SDK, rendered as Markdown, and include citations linking back to the relevant portfolio pages.
challenges: The biggest challenge was improving retrieval quality while preventing hallucinations. I refined document chunking, tuned vector search behavior, added metadata and source attribution, implemented prompt-injection protections, and iteratively improved prompts so the assistant consistently returned grounded, professional answers. Additional work included streaming responses, conversation persistence, rate limiting, and responsive chat UI design.
